highlights: The Ugreen Bright Cushion CA101 case is distinguished by the use of soft but durable TPU material, which effectively absorbs impact energy.
This makes your iPhone 16 Pro Max protected against accidental falls, reducing the risk of mechanical damage, which gives the user confidence and safety in every situation.
The case has reinforced edges with raised edges that effectively protect the screen and camera.
Thanks to them, the phone floats slightly above the surface, which prevents scratches and cracks when placing the device on hard surfaces.
Unlike standard cases, Ugreen Bright Cushion CA101 is made of a material that is resistant to yellowing.
This means that the case remains crystal clear for many months of use, maintaining its elegant appearance and emphasizing the design of the iPhone.
Double air cushion for better shock absorption
Innovative dual air cushion technology increases impact protection by absorbing the force of falls.
This solution makes your iPhone safer in difficult conditions, both during everyday use and more extreme situations.
